criteria.text: Given the Command Center, when it is opened, then every tab is reachable and every card drills down one level.
Given sample mode, when any tab is shown, then the sample data is visibly labelled as sample.

Given the Command Center, when any tab renders, then .colaberry/plan.json and .colaberry/progress.json are both committed in this repo and every tab reads its content from them at runtime rather than from hard-coded values.
Given the Command Center, when any tab is shown, then .colaberry/manifest.json is committed in this repo and every tab shows how old that data is and warns when the age exceeds a week.
Trust â no tab shows a number, a connection or a result the project has not actually produced.
Given a patient encounter, when the AI generates a note, then the clinician can review and approve it.
Given a clinician rejects a note, when they provide feedback, then the system logs the action in the audit trail.
Trust: The audit trail must show the AI's note and the clinician's approval or rejection.

stories.notes: Added approve_encounter_note and reject_encounter_note MCP tools. Audit trail (audit_log.jsonl) is the single source of truth for note status (generate_note -> approve_note|reject_note keyed by note_id), so approval/rejection is always traceable back to the AI draft it decided on.

Given a clinician edits a recommendation, when they save changes, then the edit is logged in the audit trail.
Trust: The audit trail must reflect all AI recommendations and clinician actions.

doneMeans.text: Given the Command Center, when it is opened, then every tab is reachable and every card drills down one level.
doneMeans.note: All 9 tabs built. Every card on every tab's list view now has an href to a detail page â fixed an earlier gap where several Overview cards (Requirements, Stories, Demo day, Outcomes preview, Guardrails summary) were static instead of links.

doneMeans.text: Given sample mode, when any tab is shown, then the sample data is visibly labelled as sample.
doneMeans.note: Sample banner + SAMPLE badge shown wherever fabricated data renders (Outcomes only â the one place sample data legitimately applies).

doneMeans.text: Given the data files, when any tab renders, then its content comes from .colaberry/plan.json and .colaberry/progress.json read at runtime rather than from hard-coded values.
doneMeans.note: index.html fetches both files at runtime via relative paths. A fallback snapshot exists in the JS for contexts where fetch can't reach sibling files (e.g. a single-file preview) â when served normally, fetched data overwrites it.

doneMeans.text: Given .colaberry/manifest.json, when any tab is shown, then it displays how old the data is and warns when that age exceeds a week.
doneMeans.note: Top bar shows a data-age pill on every tab, sourced from manifest.generatedAt and manifest.staleAfterDays.

doneMeans.text: Trust â no tab shows a number, a connection, or a result the project has not actually produced.
doneMeans.note: Systems and guardrail status are always real (never toggled by sample mode). Outcomes shows "Not measured yet" in real mode. Story status is honestly not-started everywhere.

decisions.text: No brand colors were supplied for MeshMedic, so the Command Center uses a neutral palette defined in one CSS token block for a later one-line swap.
Systems and guardrail statuses are treated as always-real, never toggled by sample mode â connection state and code-enforcement state are facts, not something safe to fabricate.
REQ-011 (PHI protection) has no story in the current plan that scopes its implementation directly â flagged as an open gap rather than force-mapped to an unrelated story.
